record.title: R69 causal-control learning
record.body: Durable learning: workflow fanout is not manufacturing causality. M and Y may only be promoted from current exact request -> relevant workflow -> returned receipt correspondence, with independent evidence roots discounted separately by R67. Falsifier queries that search for forbidden states must not be mistaken for forbidden behavior; verifier authority checks must distinguish observation vocabulary from asserted runtime state. Concurrent orthogonal semantic capabilities should compose by exact-parent/path-disjoint evidence when possible rather than force-rebasing or importing stale implementation substrate. R69 is default-contained at d92e65b761788c8ec18562d3d1183bce29c341f7 and composes R67 independence with R68 run closure without ambient consequential DO.

learning: observation of forbidden state != forbidden actuation
